subject.title: Feature request: config option to disable restart sentinel notification

question: Should OpenClaw add a public restart-sentinel notification suppression contract, and if so should it be global config, per-request protocol state, or both?
rationale: The remaining issue is real, but AGENTS.md and VISION.md make new config/protocol surface a high-bar product/API choice rather than an automatic repair.

options.title: Add a narrow suppression contract
options.body: Gate only the direct outbound restart notice while keeping restart wake, system events, continuation delivery, and route/thread recovery intact.

options.title: Keep current visible sentinel behavior
options.body: Preserve the existing restart visibility contract and close suppression requests as not planned after documenting the rationale.

options.title: Use per-request suppression only
options.body: Avoid a persistent config knob and let config/update callers request quiet restarts when they can prove their own user-facing confirmation path.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow suppression contract
recommendation.body: Gate only the direct outbound restart notice while keeping restart wake, system events, continuation delivery, and route/thread recovery intact.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the original gateway config/update restart flow and is the strongest available owner for choosing whether to add public config/protocol surface.
